comment: Repository submission policy. blockedContributors: accounts whose pull requests are closed without review. prohibitedWorks: subjects refused at the copyright gate; an entry may also declare matchPatterns, which close a pull request whose title or description announces it. evidence: where a skin pull request must commit the screenshots it pastes into its description, and how many are required. Enforced by .github/workflows/submission-policy.yml and scripts/submission-policy.mjs / scripts/verify-evidence.mjs.

blockedContributors.reason: Maintainer decision following the meridian skin takedown (dsh-skins commit 3807432). Pull requests from this account are closed without review.

prohibitedWorks.reason: Copyright. The character's provenance as the contributor's own original work is not established, and the maintainer has ruled the subject out of the catalog.
prohibitedWorks.description: The character created for the removed meridian skin: an anime-style young adult male with medium-length deep-blue hair, pale grey-blue eyes and dark navy clothing, presented as a DeepSeek male-character concept. Submissions that depict, trace, recolour or adapt this character are refused at intake whatever account they come from.
references: skins/meridian/ (removed in 3807432; recoverable from git history 0f86e0d)

prohibitedWorks.reason: Maintainer decision. The whole category is refused, not only the one character: a pull request whose title or description announces this type is closed without review, and a submission that turns out to depict it is refused at the copyright gate.
prohibitedWorks.description: Skins built around a DeepSeek male persona (DeepSeek 男性形象皮肤) - a male character presented as the DeepSeek image, in the manner of the removed meridian skin. This is a category rule: it covers any character in that framing, not a single design.
